# Configuration

## Where things are (compose, `.env`)

Compose reads these keys from the `.env` file next to `compose.yaml`. `./lainbow init` writes the required ones.

| Key | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `MUSIC_DIR` | required | Music folder on the host; the same folder as MPD's `music_directory`. |
| `POSTGRES_PASSWORD` | required | Password of the bundled database. |
| `ENGINE_TOKEN` | required | Token shared by the server and the bundled engine: `lbe_<32 hex digits>_<secret>`. |
| `COMPOSE_PROFILES` | required | Engine to run: `cpu`, `cuda` or `rocm`. |
| `DATA_DIR` | `./data` | Holds `postgres/` and `models/`. |
| `PORT` | `8000` | Port the API listens on. |
| `LAINBOW_VERSION` | `2` | Image tag to run. |
| `GPU_GID` | `video` | ROCm only: group that owns `/dev/kfd` and `/dev/dri`. |
| `HSA_OVERRIDE_GFX_VERSION` | unset | ROCm only: for GPUs that ROCm does not officially support, for example `11.0.0`. |

## Server settings (`LAINBOW_*`)

Optional. Put them in `.env`; the server reads every `LAINBOW_*` variable. `./lainbow config` shows the effective values.

| Variable | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `LAINBOW_DATABASE_URL` | set by compose | PostgreSQL connection URL. |
| `LAINBOW_MUSIC_DIR` | `/music` | Root of the music library, the same folder as MPD's music_directory. |
| `LAINBOW_HOST` | `0.0.0.0` | Address the HTTP server listens on. |
| `LAINBOW_PORT` | `8000` | Port the HTTP server listens on. |
| `LAINBOW_SCAN_INTERVAL_MIN` | `60` | Minutes between automatic library scans (0 = never). |
| `LAINBOW_LOCAL_ENGINE_TOKEN` | unset | Token of the engine that runs next to the server (written by `lainbow init`). |
| `LAINBOW_LEASE_SEC` | `900` | Seconds an engine may hold a track before another engine may take it. |
| `LAINBOW_TEXT_ENGINE_URL` | `http://engine:8001/` | URL of the engine that turns search text into vectors (the engine next to the server). |
| `LAINBOW_SIMILAR_CSLS_K` | `50` | Neighbours per track used to rank similar songs with CSLS, which pushes down songs that are close to everything (0 = plain cosine similarity). |
| `LAINBOW_MODELS` | `muq,muq_mulan` | Models to analyze. Available: muq, muq_mulan, clap, mert. |
| `LAINBOW_MUQ_MAX_SEC` | `180` | MuQ: seconds from the start of a track to analyze (0 = whole track) |
| `LAINBOW_MUQ_DROP_TAIL` | `False` | MuQ: drop the last min(30 s, 15%) of tracks of 60 s or longer |
| `LAINBOW_MUQ_MULAN_MAX_SEC` | `600` | MuQ-MuLan: seconds from the start of a track to analyze (0 = whole track) |
| `LAINBOW_MUQ_MULAN_DROP_TAIL` | `False` | MuQ-MuLan: drop the last min(30 s, 15%) of tracks of 60 s or longer |
| `LAINBOW_CLAP_MAX_SEC` | `600` | CLAP: seconds from the start of a track to analyze (0 = whole track) |
| `LAINBOW_CLAP_DROP_TAIL` | `False` | CLAP: drop the last min(30 s, 15%) of tracks of 60 s or longer |
| `LAINBOW_MERT_MAX_SEC` | `600` | MERT: seconds from the start of a track to analyze (0 = whole track) |
| `LAINBOW_MERT_DROP_TAIL` | `False` | MERT: drop the last min(30 s, 15%) of tracks of 60 s or longer |
| `LAINBOW_LOG_LEVEL` | `info` | Log level. |

## Analysis methods

Each model has its own analysis method, set by two variables per model:

- `LAINBOW_<MODEL>_MAX_SEC`: seconds from the start of a track to analyze (`0` = the whole track).
- `LAINBOW_<MODEL>_DROP_TAIL`: `true` drops the last min(30 s, 15%) of tracks of 60 s or longer.

`<MODEL>` is the upper-case model name, for example `MUQ_MULAN`.

Every vector is stored with a profile, a label built from the model revision and the method, such as
`r1-max180-keeptail`. Changing a method creates a new profile, so the library is analyzed again for
that model. Vectors of the previous method are kept, so changing back is free.

Default `MAX_SEC` per model: MuQ 180 s, MuQ-MuLan 600 s, CLAP 600 s, MERT 600 s.

## Engine settings

Used by the engine, for example on a GPU machine. In compose, the bundled engine gets its server URL, token and folders from `compose.yaml`.

| Variable | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `LAINBOW_SERVER_URL` | required | URL of the Lainbow server, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8000. |
| `LAINBOW_TOKEN` | required | Engine token printed by `lainbow add-engine` on the server. |
| `LAINBOW_ACCEL` | `auto` | Accelerator for the models. |
| `LAINBOW_MODELS_DIR` | `/models` | Where model weights are downloaded and cached. |
| `LAINBOW_MUSIC_DIR` | unset | Optional local mount of the music library; when a track exists here it is read directly instead of downloaded. |
| `LAINBOW_CLAIM_SIZE` | `8` | Tracks to lease at a time. |
| `LAINBOW_DECODERS` | `0` | Parallel download+decode workers (0 = number of CPU cores, at most 8). |
| `LAINBOW_TEXT_PORT` | `8001` | Port for the text-embedding endpoint used by the server (0 = off). |
| `LAINBOW_MODEL_LOADING` | `auto` | Keep all models in memory at once (together), or load one model at a time and finish its work before switching (sequential, for GPUs with little memory). auto decides from free GPU memory. |
| `LAINBOW_IDLE_SEC` | `30.0` | Seconds to wait before asking again when there is no work. |
| `LAINBOW_LOG_LEVEL` | `info` | Log level. |
